issue: Tier 1 (Byrd, The King and the God): source notation clashes with corpus — unaccented tom and wewked, ǵʰéwtōr; faithful to the source and matches the English.

'nu moy h₁éḱwoh₁ h₁ésti' uses the dual h₁éḱwoh₁ 'two stallions' for 'The stallion is mine' (sg. verb h₁ésti; the reply has sg. só h₁éḱwos). Should be h₁éḱwos. Also (minor): the narrative is incoherent — the stallion goes to h₁énos, who is told 'it is yours', but then h₁óynos 'the first' leads it away (PIE and English agree on this).
mē ḱléwseto for 'let it not be heard' uses the middle of ḱléwseti 'listen' in a passive sense — stretched. Otherwise good: h₁ím (m.) = dʰrówgʰom, lewbʰóm (n.) agrees with wékʷos, diwéy dat.
Dialogue correct: déh₃m̥ 1sg aor., dédeh₃s 2sg, h₁íh₂es f.pl. for the (f.) sheep, h₁íh₂m̥ for the sister, toy as possessor.

h₂éwim 'bird' (f.) with h₂eh₃méh₂m f. 'raw' and anaphor h₁íh₂m̥ agree; h₁ésyo 'its' for the dog; mē + injunctive dédeh₃t. Subject of the last two imperatives (the mistress) is left implicit, as in the English.
'h₂nḗr poh₂iménh₁e h₃réǵm̥ wédʰet' uses the acc. DUAL poh₂iménh₁e for 'led the shepherd' (one shepherd; the next sentence has só poh₂imḗn). Should be acc.sg. poh₂iménm̥.

Object of dʰh₁ént 'made an oath' is bʰóydʰeh₂es, the VOC.PL (retracted accent) — wrong case and number; should be acc.sg. bʰoydʰéh₂m (as in 3740aba5, 16c8f9e7). Minor also: mē + subjunctive h₂éǵōmes for the promise 'We shall not drive away' (ne is expected in a statement).
Oath formula well formed: dʰh₁dʰí wr̥h₁dʰí-kʷe, ne h₂éǵom, prohibitive mē dʰréwgʰs, tóy … deywṓs mē h₂wisih₁ént, subjunctive dʰrugʰyḗsi in the protasis.
Water ordeal: voc.pl. déywōs + 2pl perfect dedr̥ḱé 'you see'; 1sg subjunctive protases; optatives gʷr̥h₃óyh₁t, bʰéroyh₁t; perfect dedwóyh₂e 'I am afraid'.
Guest-right judgment correct throughout (dh₃dʰí, tḱéytu, woséyet). h₁opéyet 'gave' (lit. 'made reach') is a slightly stretched sense, as accepted in earlier batches.
Law clauses well formed: h₁íd (n.) = dʰéyǵʰos, h₁ím (m.) = ǵʰórtom, subjunctives in protases, h₁léwdʰerōs-kʷe … péh₂sonti 3pl.
Tier 1: Schleicher 1868 original notation (no laryngeals, a-vocalism, akwāsas, awibʰyams) is entirely unlike the corpus; faithful to the source and matches the English.
Dual subject bʰréh₂terh₁e with 3du aorist dʰh₁tā́m; 1du subjunctive h₁élh₂owos; optatives. Good.
Tier 1 (variant Schleicher fable): source notation — Hegʰnutór, moi, bracketed h₁eḱwoibʰ(y)os, weukʷét; matches the English.

'h₁yód gʷéwōm stéh₂dʰh₁eh₂ … wéyḱeti' has stéh₂dʰh₁eh₂, the NOM.PL 'herds', for 'a herd of cattle' (neut.pl. + sg. verb is grammatical but the number changes; the rest of the item has sg. stéh₂dʰh₁om). Should be stéh₂dʰh₁om. Minor also: English 'at once' has no PIE counterpart.
Correct: ḱunéh₁ instr., h₁ím (m.) for the beast, h₁íns for the piglets, 1sg/2sg imperfects h₂léksom/h₂lékses.

'tód dʰéyǵʰos bʰl̥Hós méǵh₂-kʷe h₁syéh₁t': bʰl̥Hós is masc. nom. with neuter dʰéyǵʰos (méǵh₂ beside it is correctly neuter). Engine/lexicon gap: pie-lex-bhlHos is specced as a masculine noun (shape:thematic, family noun), so no neuter bʰl̥Hóm can be built. Fix: drop or replace the adjective.
Guest law correct: mē + injunctive moréyet, h₁éy … h₁éstu, sédtu, woséyetu, tóm … h₁élh₂tu.

'túH HeHḱús h₂r̥ǵrós-kʷe' gives masculine predicates to the neuter fire, which the same text addresses with neuter n̥mr̥tóm péh₂wr̥ (personification, cf. Agni, makes it defensible). h₂r̥ǵrós is specced as a masc. noun (engine gap), so no neuter is available. swósyo for 1sg possessor is the archaic all-person reflexive — fine.
Correct: h₁ésyeh₂s f.gen. 'her', h₁íh₂ h₁léwdʰereh₂ f., h₁íd (n.) = wédʰmn̥, subjunctive protases.
'h₃érō dyéwes lewbʰós' has dyéwes, NOM.PL 'skies', for 'dear to the sky'; it should be dat.sg. diwéy (as in ae2ed34e). Case and number wrong.

'tósyo gʷówes h₂éǵrom wéyḱonti h₁édeti-kʷe': the coordinated verb h₁édeti is 3sg with plural subject gʷówes (wéyḱonti is correctly 3pl). Should be h₁dénti. Implicit subject 'her' (the sister) of h₁éptu is left to context, as in English.
Correct: intransitive middle h₁éwseto, h₁íd (n.) for the fire, h₁ím for the stall, dual démetām for the two builders, mē + injunctive.
Correct: voc. h₃réǵ, h₁éyes for the stallions, optative h₁édih₁t in the curse.
Correct: 3pl perfect dedr̥ḱḗr with deywṓs and h₁éyes, h₁íd = ḱḗr, séh₂ h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂ f., loc. h₃rḗǵi 'before the king' acceptable.
Correct: middle sékʷeto 'followed', gʷmént 3pl, h₁íns for the cattle (m.), interrogative kʷíh₁ 'how'.
Correct: dual h₁ludʰétām dwóh₁ suHnúh₁, reflexive swóm, h₁ím (m.) for the field, h₁yós … só correlative.
Correct: gen. bʰr̥h₁wéns, loc. bʰr̥h₁wéni, acc. of goal bʰréh₁wr̥, dat. ǵénh₁esey, h₁ésmōd (n.) for the spring.
